title: Phosphoproteomics-based Profiling of Kinase Activities in Cancer Cells
reason: This is a computational methods/protocol paper on phosphoproteomics kinase activity inference. It does not present new single-cell omics data, only describes tools and provides a GitHub repository. No dataset accessions or biological metadata are provided. Therefore it is not suitable for single-cell integration benchmarks.
methods_summary: Discusses computational methods to predict kinase activity scores from MS-based phosphoproteomics data. Describes databases of kinase-substrate relationships and introduces KSEA, implemented in the kinact Python toolbox available on GitHub.
